reviews.text:
I recently switched my dog Sligo, over to BLVD Lakeview Lincoln Park from a vet clinic in the suburbs and I have nothing but positive things to say! Everyone we met was great! The front desk staff were super friendly and welcoming, which made us feel comfortable right away.
Dr. Whittaker was amazing! She was so personable and took the time to listen to our concerns and explain everything clearly. The vet tech Kenny, was so friendly and knowledgeable! My dog is normally pretty nervous at the vet but he loved Dr. Whittaker and Kenny right away, which is always a good sign!
We’re really happy we found this clinic and will definitely be coming back!

Thank you for the 5 stars Tresa! We're so glad you and your pet had a great experience with our Lakeview Lincoln Park team. We appreciate you trusting BLVD Vet with their care and look forward to seeing you both at your next visit.

I've been really happy with the care my dog Lola receives at BLVD Vet. We've seen Dr. Grant and Dr. Whittaker and both were great and caring. The prices are reasonable and I like that you can get in touch with staff via your choice of email, text, or phone. Just leave yourself some extra time for parking because it can be tough in the neighborhood!

My experience was different… at first, it’s a LONG wait, at least 30 mins past our scheduled time.. then the assistant came in collecting all the information (she was not friendly unlike other reviews) , finally the doctor came in without fully understanding what treatments had done for my cat and had no clue what to do for our cat or provided me any useful advice as the follow-up… In the end, they charged me $119 of COMPREHENSIVE wellness exam but not doing anything… (no weight scaling, no heart listening, no through examinations on my cat’s fur and skin). I felt like the doctor was dodging my cat as soon as I told her that he got treated for flea a few days ago…. Not sure how they called this as a comprehensive exam…. I think I’ll visit this place again due to the convenience but definitely not going to see the same doctor and assistant again!!
They treated my dog with such care and love. Outstanding!
Vet care that is caring and knowledgeable. So glad we found Dr Bean.
Staff is incredibly friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable!
Amazing customer service. Needed a certificate to travel over seas with my pet and they made it so easy to get everything. High touch and rare customer Service excellence we don’t see often anymore

This place is amazing. Understanding the dangers of anesthesia, we were scared and tentative to put our cat through a tooth extraction and cleaning. Not only did they provide exceptional care for our beloved kitty, they provided excellent support for pre-visit and post visit care. The day of the procedure they were communicative, welcoming to questions, and considerate of our crazy cat parent concerns. We love our kitties and we are so grateful to have care that we trust. Thank you BLVD Lakeview!

Great experience! Had my new rescue pups first appointment there and they sat down on the floor with her during her visit to make her more comfortable. They also keep treats in front and encouraged us to swing by on our walks to grab a treat!
Always receive great care with my cats from Dr Grant and the assistants that help them.
The entire staff here is so nice and thorough, but Shelby deserves a special shout out. She goes above and beyond to make sure every i is dotted and t crossed. She truly is the best!!
Incredibly knowledgeable, attentive, and on-time.

We recently adopted two kittens and took them to BLVD Vet for their first exam. Everyone we interacted with was incredibly welcoming, kind, and friendly. First off, the office is impeccably clean and well-maintained. After checking in, we were guided to almost immediately to an exam room to wait. This was really nice because we could let the cats out of their carrier to explore the room before the vet came. During the check-up, Dr. Bean and the veterinary technicians who helped us were all very patient and answered all of our questions. The payment process was very transparent. Since that initial visit, we have been back twice and had great experiences (once because a kitty wasn't feeling well, and the second for getting their rabies and feline distemper shots). Dr. Grant and Dr. Strickland were both amazing, as well!

If you are looking for a Vet to care for your cats and/or dogs, look no further than BLVD - Lakeview Lincoln Park! Take it from me - mom to 2 cats & 3 dogs, these guys are top notch A#1. They have been taking care of all our pet health needs. One of our cats was recently diagnosed with diabetes. Dr. Bean has been outstanding with helping us navigate treatment, including purchasing special equipment for the office to help routinely monitor our girl. Dr. Grant sees our dogs who adore her.

They are always willing to listen to our concerns, offer up suggestions on how to proceed, as well as very communicative in keeping us informed with test results.

Last but not least the front desk staff Shelby and Maddy are terrific, great with helping us with scheduling, which can get a bit much with so many animals to keep track of.

Bottom line go to BLVD- Lakeview Lincoln Park, you won't be disappointed!

We inherited my mom’s senior cat, Mimi, after she passed away several weeks ago. Mimi is one of our greatest joys, and a reminder of the love my mom gave unconditionally, so we want her to be with us as long as possible! We decided to take Mimi to BLVD after reading great reviews. Its proximity to our home was a huge bonus as well! Shelby greeted us with tremendous kindness. Jorge and Dr. Bean were absolutely amazing during the entire exam process. They were thoughtful, kind, knowledgeable, helpful, and thorough. All of our questions and concerns were addressed and answered with genuine care and compassion. We were extremely comfortable with how treatment options for certain issues were explained and offered…nothing pushy! She was treated with gentleness and love. Thanks for taking care of our sweet girl! We are deeply grateful!❤️
I have been bringing my cats here for years and always trust the Boulevard team! They always make sure my pets are happy and feel safe and loved!

I can’t put into words how grateful I am for the staff here.  They were very knowledgeable and supportive and did everything they could for my cat. We had to put him down and they helped us throughout the entire process.

The team at the Lincoln/Lakeview office are truly one of a kind. Silvia and Dr. Bean are the reason we continue to choose this office, and drive from Logan Square. We have three cats, one with special needs, and a fairly reactive Australian Shepherd. The team at this office knows each one of our pets unique needs and they are always so comfortable whenever we visit. We have referred friends to this office, and they all feel the same way. This team is so kind and personable, and Dr. Bean always takes his time. Dr. Bean helped us find our young pup’s cancer diagnosis quickly, and guided us toward the right treatment plan with VSC. Over a whole year later, our pup has made a full remission with a clean bill of health! I love this team, and I am so grateful for the care they take in their work. You can truly feel the love and attention they provide each of our pets and that is exactly why we will always come back. Sure, there may be more affordable vet options, but at BLVD I feel like every penny is well spent, and worth it to know I am well informed, and my pets are comfortable and in very loving hands.

I can’t recommend this team enough. Thank you to Silvia, Dr. Bean, the front desk staff and the whole team. You are truly the best kind of people. Vet visits used to feel very daunting and unpredictable, and I am so relieved those days are behind us.

With love!
Emily, Tyler, Kelso, Savi, Newman and Gunk 🐾

The care from the team at BLVD is phenomenal. Everyone knows our dog by her first name, and they demonstrate genuine investment in her care. The staff always follow up after unexpected visits to see how she's doing, and they are always excited to give her treats and make sure she's happy and comfortable, even during a challenging procedure like spaying. The facility itself is beautiful, sparkling clean, and spacious; it's easy to understand why they've won some design awards. Dr. Bean's bedside manner is sweet, and Shelby at the front desk is always the highlight of our visit. We are so thrilled with our care there, and so is our dog.

Couldn't have had a better experience with BLVD! They met with my two cats, providing incredible care and were very loving with my pets. Silvia, vet tech, in particular was extremely transparent about the support they would provide, and so good with my animals. Thank you guys for all you do!
Staff are wonderful - friendly, endlessly patient with my pup and with me, really helpful and very knowledgeable. I trust their recommendations and I trust that they care about my dog!

Thanks for the 5 stars! We’re so glad you had a great experience and appreciate you taking the time to share with our vet clinic. 

Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

I am a first-time pet owner and have been so grateful to have the support and guidance from Dr. Grant and the team at BLVD Vet. I initially chose them just because of how close their location was to our home, but I genuinely couldn't imagine going anywhere else now. They are incredibly helpful, responsive, and make my life easier staying on track for all of my puppy's needs and vaccination schedule. Grateful for them!

First visit at BLVD. I have no complaints. Everything from start to finish was above 99% of the vet clinics I've been to.

I think the thing I noticed most & am most appreciative of is that there was an actual conversation between the vet assistant & me & also between the vet & me. Most vets I have gone to, interrupt me often & usually seem rushed. Both Kenny the vet tech & Dr. Bean let me explain my concerns in full. & I feel like not only was I heard but that they genuinely cared. They both took time to answer all of my questions & concerns.

I also feel like they didn't try to do or recommend any unnecessary procedures etc. & From the beginning & through every step of the way, they would tell me the cost for the visit.

While leaving, I asked Maddie the receptionist if she had any recommendations for groomers. & She took time to recommend a few & emailed them to me.

I would absolutely recommend BLVD to anyone looking for a vet.

This vet is the best. Every single person I have interacted with at BLVD is kind and willing to go out of their way to help whether I’m stopping by in person, at an appointment, or over the phone. Big shoutout to Shelby at the front desk.

My cats just got some teeth pulled and everyone was kind and updated me every step of the way with detailed verbal and written instructions for aftercare. Also the estimate ended up being more than i actually paid (3k for two cats each needing at least one tooth out to 2500 afterwards) which was a relief

The BEST vet. I’ve moved 4 times & been to 4 different vets for my cat Bugsy who has chronic issues, and Boulevdard Vet on Lakeview is hands down the best vet I’ve ever been to & the best care Bugsy has gotten. They truly care about Bugsy & they’ve taken the time to understand his long health history. They never ever make me feel like they’re rushing, they truly want to help me & Bugsy in every way they can. They’ve answered my calls to give advice even if it’s just a one off question. Their care is unbeatable. The last appointment we had was with Dr Grant & Yirald and WOW they’re incredible! We’ve been here a few times now & this is the first vet that my Bugsy doesn’t immediately jump back in his carrier. He loves them as much as they love him! I can’t speak more positively about this place. Thank you for the care you give

Thanks for the 5 stars Nicholas! We’re so glad you had a great experience and appreciate you taking the time to share. 

Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

Thank you so much for the 5-stars Katarina! We truly appreciate you taking the time to support our team. It means a lot to us, and we’re grateful for the trust you place in our care. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again!

Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

Blvd Lakeview has been an immense help in getting my dog and all the paperwork ready for our move to Australia. It is a complicated process, however, Shelby is all over it and making my role in the process a lot easier. I highly recommend Blvd Lakeview, or the other BLVD locations.
Love this vet so much. Everyone is super nice & it’s not super pricey.
It’s clear that all the staff members are knowledgeable and compassionate. So much care goes into making cats feel comfortable and fear-free here! I recommend BLVD vet to all my friends with cats :)

It’s wonderful to know you felt our care and pricing met your expectations Flavia! At BLVD Vet, we’re committed to providing excellent service and clear communication every step of the way.

Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

Just got home from our second visit to Blvdvet with our ragdoll cat, Bob. First visit was with Dr Bean and second visit was with Dr. Grant. Both times we were very pleased and impressed with quality and care they showed for Bob. Thanks, Bob is doing much better. Job well done.

The best vet! I came here after an awful experience at Duke Animal Hospital, and everything from the front desk staff, to the technicians, to the doctors are phenomenal.

One of my cats is terrified of the vet, and rather than pushing labs on her when I came in for her annual check up, Dr. Bean prescribed some medicine for her to take and then come back later for testing. This helped both me and my cat be more relaxed.

The staff is quick to relay test results through a user friendly application. Their prices are standard for the area, and there is plenty of metered parking in front of the building.
We are very happy with BLVD, everyone is very nice, they treat our dog Ruffles with so much care and patience. They answer every question we have, and explain everything very well.

I brought my cat to BLVD Vet for a check-up and she was treated exceptionally. The staff was extremely friendly and professional and all of my questions and concerns were answered. I definitely recommend BLVD Vet!
Best place ever

Thank you for the 5-star rating Chasity! We’re so glad you’ve had a positive experience with BLVD Vet. Our team is dedicated to providing compassionate, high-quality veterinary care, and we look forward to seeing you and your pets again soon!
Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

Thank you so much for your 5-star review Jillian! We’re thrilled to hear you had another positive experience with our team at BLVD Vet Lakeview–Lincoln Park. Our doctors and staff are dedicated to providing compassionate, gold-standard veterinary care for pets throughout Chicago. Your trust in us means the world, and we look forward to continuing to keep your pet family happy and healthy for years to come!
Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

Kind and comprehensive care! Made me feel more optimistic about my cat's recovery from injury by walking me through his physical exam and then helping lay out what the next couple of weeks should look like at home.

Thank you so much for the 5-star review Mackinze! We're thrilled to hear you had a 5-star experience at BLVD Vet Lakeview Lincoln Park. 

Our vet team is dedicated to helping pets live their happiest, healthiest life. We truly appreciate your trust in us and look forward to seeing you both again soon!

Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

Easy to book appointment; excellent care; knowledgeable staff. Very nice offices. Dr. Bean sent me a detailed description and estimate of possible future procedures for Bailey; I feel I can trust him and this clinic.

I've been taking my dog Rumi to BLVD Vet Lakeview location since she was 10 weeks old.  The vets, vet techs, front desk staff, and everyone else I've ever encountered has always been very friendly, professional, and detailed oriented, which is helpful when navigating a new puppy.

Rumi has had some stomach issues over the past year, between being a puppy and getting parasites, and the level of care has always been outstanding - even when I've called several times with concerns and had more appointments than not, the entire staff always closely listens to my concerns and provides detailed responses and next steps.  Dr Bean and Dr Grant have been hugely helpful recently and have given great advice on how to help Rumi recover from parasites and have recommended the right tests so we can get her stomach issues solved.

Additionally, the office is immaculately clean and even though it's the "vet", Rumi runs in and looks forward to going (probably due to the delicious treats in the back).  Can't recommend this place enough for a kind, supportive veterinary practice!

Every single person we’ve encountered at BLVD has been exceptional! Shelby is so helpful, comforting, and communicative. The vets and vet techs go above and beyond and treat their patients with so much care and love. I appreciate their willingness to listen to concerns, create treatment plans, and always go above and beyond to follow-up and check in. They are also great at fitting us in for appointments. I couldn’t be more thankful for everyone at BLVD!

We’ve been coming to Dr Bean for over a year now and we couldn’t be happier with the level of care and attention our pets are given from the entire staff! Very clean office and always on time! Highly recommend!

I cannot say enough great things about the entire team here, and particularly Dr. Bean. I first brought my 14 year old cat Mittens to BLVD with what I thought was dental issues hindering her appetite, but it turned out to be end-stage CKD. Although the diagnosis was incredibly heartbreaking, I couldn’t think of a better team to help guide us through end of life care. They were incredibly patient and kind when I cried my eyes out over the phone, and when I would bring Mittens in and she would be a little feisty.

The wonderful techs here at BLVD taught me how to administer SubQ fluids at home - which Mittens grew to love and actually look forward to - and they were so gentle with her in the treatment room. Dr. Bean would explain everything going on with Mittens in a way I could understand, and was incredibly knowledgeable.

It’s been a month since Mittens crossed the rainbow bridge, and while I’m certainly not getting another cat anytime soon, I have absolutely no doubt in my mind that if I do I will be coming right back here. Thank you for everything this team has done for Mitties.

All of the staff were super friendly! All questions got answered as thoroughly as they could. I also appreciated them explaining different parts of the bill and anything cost wise for us ahead of time. They were also very diligent time wise- we never had to wait more than a few minutes for anything!

This review is solely because the business is impossible to get a hold of.

I have tried to call the business 4 times, on 4 different days, and have never had someone answer the phone. Their website asks (prefers) that you call and speak to someone before making the animal's first appointment. But you will be sent to voicemail, and they will never return your call.

Found them once in a whim when I needed a letter for my dog to fly. Stuck with them afterwards. Everyone was always friendly and nice and my puppy loved them. We moved a bit ago but would definitely recommend.

I love the BLVD Vet Lakeview East location! The staff are friendly and will treat your pet with care. They do a great job of explaining their processes so you feel comfortable with your pets care plan. 10/10 would recommend!
Great experience, caring staff.

Let me bring my other cat for moral support even though only one was sick and was very loving towards both of them. The vet and vet assistant were very professional and answered all my questions, gave me several options for treatment, and allowed me to be a part of the treatment and exam when appropriate. Overall I feel they treated my animals with care, tenderness, and professional expertise.
Amazing staff that truly care. Dr. Grant is so kind and takes the best care of the loved ones. Thank you guys so much for your ongoing support and compassion.

I’ve been bringing my cats to BLVD Vet for about a year and highly recommend them. The staff is extremely knowledgeable, especially with cats, and always listens with empathy. My cats have seen Dr. Bean and Dr. Grant, and both have been wonderful, kind, and great with my cats. When one of my cats needed emergency care for a cruciate ligament injury at MedVet (which BLVD Vet recommends), they made it easy to share records and continue his care. One of my cats, Arthur, especially loves the staff. He loves going to the vet (he’s the one happily sitting on the vet table with toys). Also special shout out to the folks who always are so responsive via text! Y’all rock.

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a review, we're so happy to hear that you enjoyed your experience with us!
Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

My dog, Milo, felt right at home! Dr. Grant was super sweet, knowledgeable and worked hard to answer our questions when our pup wasn't feeling so well. Good quality care, owned by vets, and at a good price point!
everyone from doctor to receptionist was friendly, professional, and excited to meet my pup (:

The facility is impressive. We made an appointment and were greeted on time. Everyone was friendly and seemed knowledgeable. The test results were thorough and came back quickly. We trust Dr Bean and his staff to help us navigate pet health care.

My dogs have been patients of BLVD-Lincoln Park for about 2 years now. All of the staff are wonderful and I could not recommend them highly enough! We primarily see Dr. Bean, but we have also seen Dr. Grant. Both doctors are lovely and very knowledgeable. I trust them to help me make informed decisions about my pets’ health. Appointments are very thorough while also being efficient. I will continue to come to this location and recommend them to others.

Thank you so much, Leanette! We are so happy to hear that you enjoyed your experience with us!
Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

Thank you so much for your review, Jillian! We are so happy to hear that you enjoyed your experience!
Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

Thank you so much, Amanda! We're so happy to see that you enjoyed your experience with us!
Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

Thank you so much, Andrew! We're so pleased to hear that you enjoyed your experience!
Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

I cannot say enough good things about this clinic, Dr. Bean, and the whole team here!! I have a very skittish little corgi and the team does so well with him and makes him feel at ease. He even gets excited when I tell him we’re going to see Dr. Bean. They do such a good job making sure he’s healthy and happy, they explain everything thoroughly, offer advice, and are very transparent about all costs. My pup also has some mild separation anxiety and was starting to howl and dedicate indoors any time I left him alone. I tried all the holistic things and we decided it was time for medicinal intervention. He ended up getting on Trazodone and omg what a difference! I was nervous about putting him on medication that he wouldn’t be himself anymore, but now he doesn’t panic when I leave and is still the same happy, playful boy. I feel like I got my life back and can feel at ease when he has to stay behind. I just can’t thank this team enough for everything they do!
Highly recommend!!

I have always taken my cats to BLVD (either the Ravenswood or Lakeview/Lincoln Park locations), so I was unsurprisingly very happy with my most recent experience, when my cat Lola had a dental procedure. Lola is an anxious kitty and I was a little nervous about bringing her in for a procedure in which she would have to be anesthetized, but BLVD made sure I was fully informed, answered all of my questions, and kept me updated about Lola's status on the day of the procedure. They took great care of Lola and I will always recommend them to anyone with pets in Chicago!

I appreciated the timeliness of the entire visit! The veterinarian was clearly grounded and present with my cat and myself, not rushing the visit in any way, taking the time to prompt and answer questions.

Thank you so much for your review, Sarabeth! It means a lot to hear that you enjoyed your experience with us!
Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

Just had my cat’s teeth cleaned here and they did an amazing job. The office is super nice and everyone there is very professional. They’re also great at communicating everything related to the procedure and their website has a ton of resources that explain everything clearly with videos. Super impressed

Our vet (Kait) was so patient with my questions and concerns and didn't try to rush the visit. She made recommendations for supplementary treatments without forcing us to take them up. Kanson and I can't wait to visit again for our next appointment!
They take very good care of my cat. Clean facility and very friendly and knowledgeable staff!
Thank you for the positive feedback, Sean! It means a lot to us that you took the time to leave a review. Please give Iggy and Lou a cuddle from us.
Amazing experience! The staff made it a priority to ensure that my cat was relaxed during his exam. They were all very patient with him, which I appreciated.
Always prompt and caring service

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a review, Haley! We're so glad to hear that you enjoyed your experience!
Sincerely,
Marina
Practice Manager

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a review, Jeremy! We're so happy to hear that you enjoyed your experience!
Sincerely, … More
We've been with BLVD vet for 7 years and always have a great experience with their team.

Slightly condescending and abrasive with us and our reactive dog, felt like money was more important than connection and real care for our canine family member. We had a wonderful experience at the Logan Square location with Dr. Brill.

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a review, Alyssa! We're so happy to hear that you enjoyed your experience with us!
Sincerely, … More
